# Manthan Anejaa — Nadi Astrologer

> Manthan Anejaa (Manthan K Anejaa) is one of the best Nadi Astrologers in Haryana, India. He combines and analyses Nadi Astrology, Numerology and Palmistry to accurately predict past, present and future through his signature Trikal Darshan method. He has hundreds of 5-star reviews and a worldwide client base across Canada, USA, UK and Australia. He practises Saatvik Jyotish with no remedies, no gemstones and no fear tactics.
